---
title: "Family Structure in Sarasota County, FL (2005–2024)"
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# Load the 20-year Sarasota County ACS 1-year dataset
sarasota_history <- read_rds("data/sarasota_history.rds")

# Reshape the household structure columns into long format using whole household counts
family_trends <- sarasota_history |>
  select(
    year,
    `Married-couple family` = married_couple_fam,
    `Nonfamily household (living alone / roommates)` = nonfamily_households,
    `Single-mother / female householder family` = female_householder_fam,
    `Single-father / male householder family` = male_householder_fam
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -year,
    names_to = "household_type",
    values_to = "households"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    household_type = fct_reorder(household_type, households, .fun = max, .desc = TRUE)
  )

# Plot how household counts changed over the last 20 years (in whole numbers)
ggplot(family_trends, aes(x = year, y = households, color = household_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2005, 2024, by = 3)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    title = "Twenty Years of Household & Family Structure in Sarasota County",
    subtitle = "Total number of households by type, 2005–2024 (2020 omitted due to Census COVID-19 gap)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Households",
    color = "Household Type",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 1-Year American Community Survey (Table B11001)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 10

library(sf)

# Load statewide Florida county data with map boundaries
fl_counties <- read_rds("data/fl_counties.rds")

# Calculate average number of children per family with children in each Florida county
fl_kids_map <- fl_counties |>
  mutate(
    families_with_kids = married_with_kids + single_father_kids + single_mother_kids,
    avg_kids = kids_under_18 / families_with_kids
  ) |>
  st_as_sf()

# Plot Florida counties shaded by average children per family with kids, outlining Sarasota County
ggplot(fl_kids_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = avg_kids), color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(
    data = filter(fl_kids_map, GEOID == "12115"),
    fill = NA,
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    limits = c(1, 3),
    breaks = c(1, 2, 3),
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 1),
    name = "Avg. Kids\nper Family"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Number of Children per Family (with Kids) Across Florida Counties",
    subtitle = "Children under 18 divided by families with children (Sarasota County outlined in red)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2018–2022 5-Year ACS (Tables B09001 & B11003)"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(margin = margin(b = 10))
  )
```
